job.job_description:
Experience: 2-4 Years
Job Type: Full-Time

Job Description

We are looking for a talented Python Developer with 2 - 4 years of experience to join our development team. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Python, React JS, and HTML and be passionate about building modern, responsive, and high-performance web applications.

Mandatory Skills

Python
React JS
HTML5
CSS3
JavaScript
REST API Integration
Git

Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain web applications using React JS and Python.
Build responsive and user-friendly UI components.
Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs.
Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code.
Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile environment.
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions.

Required Qualifications

24 years of professional experience in web application development.
Strong proficiency in Python programming.
Hands-on experience with React JS and modern JavaScript.
Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web design.
Experience working with REST APIs.
Good understanding of Git/version control.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

Experience with FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
Knowledge of Redux or Context API.
Familiarity with AWS and CI/CD pipelines.
Understanding of software development best practices.

Education

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
